name: ⭐Catalog Avatar Runway
desc:
👑 EVERY OUTFIT YOU MAKE IS SENT TO AVATAR OUTFIT CATALOG!

No requirements, no grinding. Any outfit you put real effort into is automatically ported over to AVATAR OUTFIT CATALOG, where you can look at it whenever you want:

https://www.roblox.com/games/86145498709536/Avatar-Outfit-Catalog

⏳ Heads up: imports can take a while. Runway runs far higher CCU than Shopping, so there's a large backlog

💃 Avatar Runway is a social fashion runway game where players vote on themes, design avatar looks, walk the runway, rate outfits, and compete for the top podium spots.

✨ Create your own style, build the best look for each theme, use catalog items and emotes, and show off your outfit in front of other players.

🗳️ Vote for the next theme and watch every round become a new fashion challenge.

🏆 Compete with friends and other players to earn wins, climb the leaderboards, and become the top runway model.

✅ Purchased items are added to your Roblox inventory and can be used across Roblox

llm.loop: vote on a theme -> build an outfit from catalog items -> walk the runway -> rate others -> win podium spots
llm.objectives: win runway rounds and climb leaderboards
llm.instructions: vote on themes, design looks, walk the runway, rate outfits
unique: outfits are exported to a sister 'Avatar Outfit Catalog' game
llm.thumbnails: stylish avatar with long hair on a dark/glow background
